title: A fractional Brezis-Nirenberg problem with multipolar Hardy potentials
summary: We study a fractional Brezis--Nirenberg problem on a bounded domain with finitely many Hardy potentials centered at distinct points $a_1,\dots,a_k$, with masses $μ_1,\dots,μ_k\geq 0$. We assume $\sum_{i=1}^kμ_i 4s$ and $0<μ_{\max}<\overlineμ_{N,s}$. The interaction between the poles allows existence for $λ=0$ and for some negative values of $λ$. At a pole $a_j$, this interaction is described by $B_j(λ,\mathbf a,\boldsymbolμ)=λ+\sum_{i\neq j}\frac{μ_i}{|a_i-a_j|^{2s}}$. This leads to a threshold $λ_{\mathrm{geo}}\leq 0$.
